title: Relay-ramp linkage corridors between en-echelon normal-fault strands (catalogue-only, deterministic)
lane_assignment_note: No single method paragraph identifiable in supplied 2026-10-21 prompt; this session declares one new narrow lane before Exp 1, per Parallel-Run Protocol Lane rule. Does not retune any stopped lane.
hypothesis: Blind transfer faults linking overlapping en-echelon normal-fault segments via relay ramps are dilatational, geothermal-favorable, and under-mapped under basin fill. Catalogue is scarp-biased; relay interiors are blind spot. Deterministic linkage corridors between parallel, overlapping, close strands should recover withheld segments.
mimic: En-echelon lithologic contacts, digitisation fragments split by raster gaps, or already-linked segments mis-split could mimic.

inputs.catalogue_geometry_only: data/bridge/existing_faults.tif SHA 7ba308cc... footprint from sample_submission.tif SHA 2176d08e...
inputs.forbidden: No training_features, no geophysics, no lidar, no radiometric — zero SGMC channels

fixed_transform.component_definition: Connected components of (existing_faults==1) via 8-connectivity; keep >=5 px (2498 of 25092) for orientation
fixed_transform.orientation: PCA on pixel coords, largest eigenvector angle

corridor_geometry.aggregation: Max over pairs, mask to allowed = footprint & ~catalogue

fixed_transform.leakage_control: Component-LOCO: component usable iff no pixel within 5 px of hidden truth and endpoints >=10 px inside footprint

emission.method: Greedy max-coverage min-separation 3.0 px over allowed

experiments.name: Pooled HOLDOUT-DTI vs controls
steps: Compare vs controls, pooled DTI + CI
stop_rules: If CI below incumbent and random, verdict negative

experiments.name: Dot emission + artifact + uniqueness
stop_rules: Literal overlap>0.70 expected under Policy I17; report both

promotion: No slot. Require canaries <=0.90, uniqueness, complete scan, improvement over 0.1527 before selector.
expected_improvement: Unknown; hypotheses are ordinal priorities, never projected scores
